In [[3956 BBY]], a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] worked as a '''bartender''' in the [[Ahto Cith mercenary enclave|mercenary enclave]] located in [[Ahto City/Legends|Ahto City]], on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], including [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] and [[Battle stimulant/Legends|battle stimulants]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}
